errata.error: These 3 USGS series hold levels no gauge can read, outside the store's span of −500 to 9,000 m: 10 values in 2026, −99,999 ft (−30,479.695 m) and values from −3,032 to −34,253 m.
errata.response: The store leaves out a level outside its span (`SPAN_M` in src/span.ts) wherever it fetches levels, and requalify drops any it holds. A year file of nothing else keeps its rows, flagged `bad`, with a warning.
errata.evidence: November 2026. A scan of the range of levels in every year file of every source in the store (335,320 files) found 383 holding a level outside the span, which were then read in full; each of them also has a `bad` value, as QC flags every level outside the span.
